name: Patirna Shinku
source: One of the Yun Gasol Union Three Musketeers. Patrina uses intuition rather than head to see through enemy. With tactics taken care of by Ruinn, and weapons made ​​by Elmina, she fights in order to bring victory to Yun Gasol Union with her own arms.
